title: Mastering UI Toggles
summary: This lesson breaks down the anatomy, animation, and accessibility of a high-quality toggle switch. It covers geometric ratios, multi-property transitions, and optimistic UI patterns for a better user experience.

transcript.text: Two toggles. One snaps. One morphs.
Rail width is knob diameter times two. Padding equals knob radius. These ratios make the knob feel anchored.
Don't snap. Morph four properties at once. Rail color, knob slide, knob shadow, label crossfade, all in 250 milliseconds, ease out.
Spacebar toggles, visible focus ring, ARIA announces the state change. Skip these and it's a fake button. Real switches work without a mouse.
Flip first. Spinner in the knob. Server says no, roll back. The user never waits for the network.
Follow for more UI components. Save this for your next switch.

on_screen_text: Rail color, Knob slide, Knob shadow, Label
Space toggles. Focus rings. ARIA reads.
Flip first. Spinner in the knob. Roll back if it fails.
before_after: A basic 'snapping' toggle compared to a polished 'morphing' toggle with smooth transitions and accessibility features.
